source: 627 Treatment Plan?
target: Consilium Curandi 627?

source: Lumian had initially theorized the presence of multiple Demons on Hanth Island, specifically the sealed blood-colored Demon and the ice-blue-eyed Demon.
target: Lumian initio coniectavit de praesentia plurium daemonum in Insula Hanth, praesertim daemonem sanguine coloratum sigillatum atque daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis.

source: However, to his astonishment, he discovered various ice-blue-eyed Demons—in the cathedral!
target: Tamen, ad stuporem eius, invenit plures daemonos oculis glacie caeruleis in ecclesia!

source: How many Demons inhabit this island?
target: Quot daemones hac insula inhabitant?

source: Are they all part of the same family with ice-blue eyes?
target: Num omnes eandem familiam, cum oculis glacie caeruleis, constituunt?

source: As expected of the Mother of All Things.
target: Ut a Matre Omnium Rerum exspectatur.

source: Even a Demon can be Her child.
target: Etiam daemon filius eius esse potest.

source: A whole nest of them!
target: Totus eorum nidus!

source: As thoughts swirled in Lumian’s mind, accompanied by those piercing ice-blue eyes and the name Naboredisley, he felt that his previous investigations and speculations were completely off course.
target: Dum cogitationes in mente Luminiani vortebantur, comitatae oculis acutis glacie caeruleis et nomine Naboredisley, sensit indagationes atque speculationes praeteritas omnino erravisse.

source: The complexity and mystery surrounding the legend of the Demons on Hanth Island surpassed his initial imagination.
target: Complexitas et mysterium legendae daemonum in insula Hanth initialem eius imaginationem superaverunt.

source: No, there are still gains and benefits…
target: Non, adhuc sunt utilitates et beneficia…

source: Speculation involves bold assumptions and careful confirmation.
target: Speculatio audaces coniecturas et diligens confirmationem implicat.

source: It’s normal for initial assumptions to be overturned.
target: Communum est ut primae coniecturae refutentur.

source: The elimination method is a crucial deduction tool…
target: Methodus eliminationis instrumentum deductionis praecipuum est…

source: How can there be unsolved cases that are guessed completely correct from the beginning?
target: Quomodo casus insoluti, qui ab initio omnino recte coniecti sunt, exsistere possunt?

source: The crucial aspect lies in consistently refuting the incorrect path through falsification and integrating new information acquired during the investigation to uncover the right one…
target: Aspectus crucialis in constanti refutatione viae erroneae per falsificationem et integratione novarum informationum, quae in inquisitione adeptae sunt, ad viam rectam inveniendam consistit.

source: Heh heh, if I were to take the Reader pathway, it should be relatively straightforward for me to act the role of a Detective.
target: Heh heh, si viam Lectoris elegissem, satis facile mihi fore debet ut munus Detectivi peragarer.

source: Discerning a conspiracy stands out as one of the primary duties of a Detective…
target: Coniurationem discernere inter praecipua Detectivi officia eminet.

source: Lumian reassured himself, disentangling from the impact of the two ice-blue-eyed Demons.
target: Lumian se consolatus est, dissolvens ictum duorum daemonum oculis glacie caeruleis.

source: He regained his clarity and rationality, no longer feeling befuddled and disoriented.
target: Claritatem atque rationem iterum adeptus est, neque amplius turbatus aut confusus se sentiens.

source: Under the blistering sunlight, he swiftly identified an issue.
target: Sub sole ferventi, celeriter rem deprehendit.

source: In the scene I witnessed through the Mystery Prying Glasses, the blood-colored Demon was pulled by an invisible force, but there was only one invisible force, and only a pair of ice-blue eyes gazed at me…
target: In scena, quam per oculos indagatores mysterii conspexi, daemon sanguine coloratus ab invisibili vi tractus est, sed una tantum vis invisibilis aderat, atque solum par oculorum glacie caeruleorum ad me intuebatur.

source: There’s only one ice-blue-eyed Demon closely linked to the blood-colored Demon, and that’s the elder Boselli who repented before the Sacred Emblem of Life.
target: Tantum est unus daemon, oculis glacie caeruleis, qui arcte coniungitur cum daemon sanguine colorato, atque ille est senior Boselli, qui coram Insigne Sacrum Vitae paenitentiam egit.

source: The others, including the ice-blue-eyed clergyman, are its descendants.
target: Reliqui, inter quos etiam clericus oculis glacie caeruleis, eius posteri sunt.

source: Could they be the offspring it left behind with the nuns when it used the Hanth Island’s cloister to ‘restore its youth’ and obtain a new identity?
target: Possuntne illi esse progenies quas reliquit cum monachis, quum claustrum Insulae Hanth ad iuventutem restitutam et novam identitatem adipiscendam usus est?

source: However, when the ice-blue-eyed clergyman mentioned Boselli, it didn’t sound like it was referring to its father, grandfather, or ancestor.
target: Sed cum clericus oculis glacie caeruleis Boselli nominavit, non videbatur referre ad patrem, avum aut progenitorem.

source: It was as if it was discussing a friend with whom it didn’t share an amicable relationship…
target: Sicut de amico loqueretur, cui vinculum amicitiae non haberet.

source: Moreover, it also identifies itself as Naboredisley…
target: Porro, se ipse etiam Naboredisley appellat…

source: Could this be a family name?
target: Poteritne hoc esse nomen familiae?

source: A significant family name among the Abyss Demons?
target: Nomen familiae insignis inter daemonos Abyssos?

source: Puzzled, Lumian boarded the Berries and returned to his first-class suite.
target: Perplexus, Lumian in "Berries" conscendit et ad cellam suam primae classis rediit.

source: At that moment, Lugano and Ludwig were relishing a lavish lunch.
target: Illo tempore, Lugano ac Ludwig prandium opulentum degustabant.

source: Upon spotting Lumian, the Doctor grinned sheepishly and said, “I thought you’d be indulging in the local delights on the island, so I didn’t wait for you.”
target: Cum Lumianum animadvertit, Medicus verecunde subsurridens dixit: “Putabam te in deliciis loci insulae frui, ideo te non exspectavi.”

source: Lumian sat down and grabbed a wheat-flavored bun. As he chewed, he asked thoughtfully,
target: Lumian consedit et paniculam triticeam arripuit; dum masticabat, caute rogavit:

source: “What do you know about the abilities of the Planter pathway?”
target: “Quid de facultatibus viae Plantatoris nosti?”

source: Lugano hesitated for a moment before truthfully responding, “Sequence 9 Planter significantly boosts my strength.
target: Lugano paulisper cessavit antequam sincero respondit: “Secuencia IX Plantator vires meas significanter auget.

source: I can predict the weather to a certain extent by observing clouds, wind, and other natural phenomena.
target: Tempestatem ad aliquam mensuram praedicere possum, nubibus, vento, et aliis phaenomenis naturalibus inspiciens.

source: I’m adept at identifying seeds and nurturing them.
target: Sementes agnoscere et colere peritus sum.

source: Farming tools suit me more than knives and guns.”
target: Instrumenta agriculturae mihi magis conveniunt quam cultri et tormenta.”

source: “Sequence 8 Doctor’s primary abilities revolve around healing.
target: “Secuencia VIII Medici principales facultates in curatione consistunt.

source: They can discern the patient’s specific situation through Spirit Vision.
target: Per Visionem Spiritus possunt statum specificum aegroti discernere.

source: They possess outstanding surgical skills, such as suturing severed limbs and transplanting internal organs.
target: Praeterea, excellentem artem chirurgicam habent, ut conexuram membrorum secatorum et transplantationem organorum internorum.

source: Additionally, we gain Beyonder abilities like Evil Ailment Treatment, Trauma Treatment, Soul Suture, and Life-Giving.
target: Insuper, adepti sumus facultatum Beyonder, ut Curatio Morborum Malorum, Curatio Traumatica, Sutura Animae, et Vivificatio.”

source: “As far as I know, the next Sequence is called Harvest Priest.
target: “Quod mihi nota est, proximus sequens vocatur Sacerdos Messis.

source: It mainly focuses on promoting the reproduction and growth of creatures and bringing about a bumper harvest with Beyonder powers…”
target: Praecipue intendit ad promotionem reproductionis et incrementi creaturarum, atque ad abundans messis per potentias Beyonder efficiendam…”

source: Upon hearing this, Lumian suddenly interrupted Lugano.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian subito Lugano interpellavit.

source: “Soul Suture?
target: “Sutura Animae?

source: “How is this implemented?”
target: “Quomodo hoc perficitur?”

source: Lugano grinned sheepishly and said, “I haven’t really used this ability yet.
target: Lugano, verecunde risu, dixit: “Hanc facultatem nondum vere usus sum.

source: It’s used to treat soul injuries.
target: Ad vulnera animae curanda ea utitur.

source: As you know, some superpowers can attack the soul, making it difficult for it to heal on its own.
target: Ut nosti, quaedam virtutes supernaturales animam oppugnare possunt, ita ut per se ipsa sanari difficile fiat.

source: At this moment, as long as the injured let go of their bodies and minds and don’t resist, I can carry out a soul-level surgery to stitch up the corresponding wound.”
target: Hoc tempore, dummodo vulnerati corpora et mentes suas dimitterint nec resisterint, possum in scala animae operationem chirurgicam ad vulneris suturam perficere.”

source: Lumian’s concern wasn’t about stitching up a soul; it was another matter that provided him with a fresh perspective on the Demon legends of Hanth Island.
target: In Luminiano sollicitudo non de sutura animae erat; alia enim res novam perspicientiam de legendis daemonum in insula Hanth ei attulit.

source: He downed the pre-meal bun and took a sip of the golden liqueur.
target: Prandii paniculam edidit et liquorem aureum sorpit.

source: After a moment of contemplation, he inquired, “Since you can suture souls, from a different standpoint, can you also sever souls?”
target: Post momentum meditationis, interrogavit: “Cum animae suturam efficere possis, ex alia parte, potesne etiam animas secare?”

source: Lugano fell silent.
target: Lugano silentium cepit.

source: After ten to twenty seconds, he responded, “Theoretically, yes, but it requires the corresponding person to completely open up their body and mind, leaving their soul unprotected.
target: Post decem ad viginti secundas respondit: “Theoretice, ita; sed requirit ut persona sua corpus ac mentem penitus aperiat, relinquens animam sine tutela.

source: It would be even more effective if their physical body doesn’t exist.”
target: Illud etiam melius valeret, si corpus physicum non exsistat.”

source: The Doctor hesitated for a moment before adding, “This can serve as an attack on the soul, but it could also be a treatment method.
target: Medicus breviter dubitavit antequam addidit: “Hoc potest uti impetu contra animam, sed etiam methodus curationis esse potest.

source: If a patient’s soul is corrupted by a curse, they can address it by severing the depravity and allowing their soul to gradually heal.”
target: Si anima aegroti a maledictione corrupta sit, eam operari possunt separando pravitatem et sinendo animam paulatim sanari.”

source: Upon hearing this, Lumian smiled and applauded softly.
target: His audita, Lumian subridens leniter plausit.

source: “Well said. Well said.”
target: “Bene locutum. Bene locutum.”

source: Lugano, being thick‑skinned, couldn’t help but feel a bit embarrassed by the praise.
target: Lugano, animi duritiam habens, non potuit parum erubescere laude.

source: He blurted out, “That’s just my speculation. I haven’t tested it yet.”
target: Impromptu exclamat: “Hoc solum est mea speculatio; nondum id experientia probavi.”

source: Lumian ignored him and proceeded to emulate what Ludwig had done.
target: Lumian eum contempsit et imitari id quod Ludwig perfecerat accessit.

source: He forked a lamb chop onto his plate and began cutting with determination.
target: In patellam sua agnum lumbolum traiecit et cum studio secare coepit.

source: Simultaneously, the initial sensations when he faced the onslaught of the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon resurfaced in Lumian’s mind.
target: Simul, sensus initii, cum daemon oculis glacie caeruleis impetum oppugnatum expertus esset, in mente Luminiani recensuerunt.

source: He witnessed diverse versions of himself—a version brimming with hatred, another immersed in pain, one engrossed in lust, and another consumed by various desires and emotions…
target: Se diversas partes sui conspexit: una odio repleta, altera dolore immersa, una libidine absorpta, et altera variis cupiditatibus atque affectibus consumpta…

source: As Lugano detailed the process of suturing and soul‑severing, an idea sparked in Lumian’s mind.
target: Dum Lugano processum suturae atque animarum secedendi enarrabat, idea in mente Luminiani nata est.

source: What if the High‑Sequence abilities of the Planter pathway were employed to excise different aspects of the soul corresponding to various desires?
target: Quid si potentiae altæ sequentiae viae Plantatoris ad excidendos diversos aspectus animae, quos diversas cupiditates respondent, adhiberentur?

source: Could there truly be just one ice‑blue‑eyed Demon on Hanth Island, but its soul had been partitioned by the Saints and even Angels of the Church of Earth Mother, each becoming an individual?
target: Num vere sit solus unus daemon oculis glacie caeruleis in insula Hanth, cum anima eius a Sanctis atque etiam Angelis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae divisa sit, singulis fiendo?

source: On a mystical level, they remain a single entity.
target: In sensu mystico unum ens manent.

source: Hence, is there only one invisible force closely tied to the blood‑colored Demon?
target: Itaque, num sola una vis invisibilis, quae arcte cum daemon sanguine colorato conexa sit, exsistat?

source: The question now is—why would the Church of Earth Mother undertake such an action?
target: Quaestio nunc est: cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae talem actionem suscipiat?

source: Imposing restrictions or offering protection? Perhaps both?
target: Restricta imponere aut tutela praebere? Fortasse utrumque?

source: Lumian swiftly linked this with the state of the blood‑colored Demon.
target: Lumian celeriter hoc cum statu daemon sanguine colorati coniunxit.

source: It consistently descended into the pitch‑black sewage before being hoisted up by an unseen force.
target: Constanter in cloacas atris descendebat, antequam ab invisibili vi sublevaretur.

source: Splitting the soul acted as a shield for the ice‑blue Demon, preventing corruption from the power of the pitch‑black sewage?
target: Divisio animae scutum fuit daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, corruptionem a potentia cloacarum atrorum prohibens?

source: Wait, could the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon be the untainted segment of the blood‑colored Demon’s soul?
target: Exspecta, num daemon oculis glacie caeruleis sit pars integra et immaculata animae daemon sanguine colorati?

source: Is the Church of Earth Mother’s approach based on deeming the entire body beyond salvation, but parts are still considered healthy?
target: An modus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae consistit, ut totum corpus ultra salutem existimet, sed aliquae partes adhuc sanum reputentur?

source: Is that why a healthy soul needs to be severed into different desires?
target: Itaque an anima sana in varias cupiditates secanda sit?

source: The forest sealing off the mysterious valley, pitch‑black sewage, and the blood‑colored Demon displayed characteristics of rebirth, growth, depravity, death, and rebirth again…
target: Silva, quae vallem arcanam obtegebat, cloacae atri, atque daemon sanguine coloratus, naturam regenerationis, incrementi, pravitatis, mortis atque rursus regenerationis exhibuerunt…

source: The soul fragments of the blood‑colored Demon were given new life, enabling them to utilize the cycle of rebirth, growth, aging, death, and rebirth again to resist the corruption spreading from their true bodies?
target: Fragmenta animae daemon sanguine colorati vitam novam acceperunt, quae eis permisit ut cyclum regenerationis, incrementi, senectutis, mortis atque rursus regenerationis ad corruptionem ex corporibus veris diffundentem oppugnare valeant.

source: Simultaneously, relying on the existence of the healthy parts prevented the blood‑colored Demon from sinking entirely?
target: Simul, innixus existentiae partium sanarum, daemon sanguine coloratus ne omnino submergeretur impedivit.

source: Aging soul fragments are inherently more vulnerable to corruption from the main body, and newborns are the healthiest.
target: Fragmenta animae senescens naturaliter magis ad corruptionem ex corpore principali occasionem habent, atque recenti optime valent.

source: This explains why the old Boselli and the ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman are in different states…
target: Hoc explicat cur senior Boselli et clericus oculis glacie caeruleis in diversis condicionibus sint…

source: Such a newborn possesses a Demon’s potent soul, but its human body is exceedingly frail.
target: Talis neonatus potentem animam daemonis habet, sed corpus humanum eius exiguum est.

source: Yes, it aligns with my observations of Boselli.
target: Ita, id congruit cum meis observationibus de Boselli.

source: Its feeble and aged body encases a potent soul teeming with malevolence…
target: Corpus eius infirmum atque senescentem potentem animam, malitia ferventem, amplectitur…

source: This… This method of sealing and rescuing aligns with the Church of Earth Mother’s unique abilities…
target: Ista… ista methodus sigillandi et eripiendi congruit cum unigenis facultatibus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae…

source: With these revelations, Lumian felt enlightened.
target: His revelationibus, Lumian se illuminatum esse sensit.

source: Only then did he realize that he had been continuously cutting the lamb chop’s bones, producing a grinding sound.
target: Tum intellexit se ossa costarum agni continue secare atque sonum molientem efficere.

source: Lugano pretended not to notice or hear anything, focusing on enjoying his meal.
target: Lugano simulavit nihil animadvertere aut audire, animum in cibo fruendo incumbens.

source: Ludwig paid no attention to such trivial matters, wholly absorbed in the delicacies.
target: Ludwig harum rerum levium nihil animadvertit, penitus in delicatissimis immersus.

source: Lumian withdrew his gaze and happily poured himself a glass of Paha red wine.
target: Lumian oculos avertit atque laetus sibi poculum vini rubri Paha infundit.

source: The confusion, disorder, loss, and disappointment he had previously experienced dissipated significantly.
target: Confusio, inordinatio, amissio atque deiectio, quas antea passa erat, valde evanuerunt.

source: As he drank, he leisurely pondered, “This hypothesis aligns most with the current details.”
target: Dum bibeat, tranquille meditatus est: “Haec hypothesi maxime congruit cum indicibus praesentibus.”

source: Unfortunately, it can’t be verified, nor do I dare to.
target: Infeliciter, verificari non potest, nec ausus sum.

source: And without verification and results, there’s no feedback for the potion’s digestion…
target: Et sine verificatione atque eventibus, nullum responsum ad digestionem potionis praestatur…

source: Forget it.
target: Eia, dimitte.

source: The experience and lessons I gained this time are much more important than the digestion I can still attempt in the future.
target: Experientia atque lectiones, quas hoc tempore accepi, multo magni momenti sunt quam digestio, quam in futurum adhuc conari possum.

source: Why does the Church of Earth Mother want to protect the blood‑colored Demon?
target: Cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae daemon sanguine coloratus protegere cupit?

source: Moreover, since a healthy soul has been separated and given new life, why not completely destroy and purify the corrupted true form to eliminate any hidden dangers?
target: Praeterea, cum anima sana divisus novaque vita donata sit, cur non totam formam corruptam vere delendam atque purgandam esse putetur, ut omnia pericula occulta deleantur?

source: There’s a high chance that this involves the world’s deep secrets…
target: Magna est probabilitas quod hoc involvat arcana profunda mundi…

source: Is that blood‑colored Demon the true and largest Naboredisley?
target: Num iste daemon sanguine coloratus verus atque maximus Naboredisley sit?

source: Was the one seeking a deal to slay Hanth Island’s Demon descendant it?
target: Num ille, qui foedum quaerebat ad interficendum daemon Insulae Hanth, eius descendentia fuerit?

source: Can it, in turn, affect a few soul fragments, allowing me and a Mid‑Sequence Beyonder like Franca to slay a true Demon?
target: Num poterit id, vicissim, afficere pauca fragmenta animae, quae mihi atque Beyonder mediocris, qualis Franca, concedant daemonem verum interficere?

source: The more Lumian contemplated, the more curious he became about the truth.
target: Quo magis Lumian meditavit, eo magis de veritate inquisitivus factus est.

source: However, he eventually restrained himself.
target: Sed denique se continuit.

source: For Beyonders at his level, this matter was concluded.
target: Nam, ad gradum eius pertinentibus Beyonder, haec quaestio conclusa erat.

source: After leaving Hanth Island, he would report his gains and speculations to Madam Magician and consult the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana card holders.
target: Postquam Insulam Hanth deseruit, lucri ac speculationes suas ad Dominam Magician referret atque cum possessoribus chartarum Major Arcana Tarot Club consuleret.

source: Lumian, putting aside his investigative thoughts, felt a sense of relief.
target: Lumian, cogitationes investigatorias deponens, levationem sensit.

source: He spent the rest of his time leisurely strolling through Port Hanth.
target: Reliquam temporis partem in Portu Hanth tranquille ambulans egit.

source: To his surprise, he realized that the Berserk Sea island city, far from the Feynapotter Kingdom, didn’t have a genuine casino.
target: Ad stuporem, intellexit urbem insularum Maris Furibundi, procul a Regno Feynapotter sita, genuinum casinum non habere.

source: There were no criminal industries like human trafficking.
target: Industriae scelestae, ut commercium humanum, non exstabant.

source: It was as clean as if it had been purified by the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
target: Erat tam purum, quasi Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Incandescentis illum purgasset.

source: After engaging in Fighting Evil and other card games throughout the afternoon, Lumian, with wins and losses not exceeding 1 gold risot, finally grasped the reason.
target: Postquam per totum postmeridiani tempus in ludis “Fighting Evil” aliisque chartaceis versatus est, Lumian, cuius lucrum ac damnum unum aureum risot non excedebat, tandem causam perspexit.

source: Unable to control themselves, the ice‑blue‑eyed Demons prioritized the malevolent wrongdoers, making them vanish into the forest outside the city.
target: In se continere nequentes, daemon oculis glacie caeruleis scelestores praevaluerunt, eos in silvam extra urbem evanescere fecisse.

source: As time—a century or two—elapsed, Port Hanth could be deemed a city bathed in sunlight.
target: Cum tempus—saeculum vel duo—transierit, Portus Hanth ut urbs lumine infusa esse potuit.

source: Certainly, there were innocents among them, like Antonio Elias.
target: Certe, inter eos innocentes, sicut Antonio Elias, erant.

source: Late at night, in the first‑class cabin suite of the Berries.
target: Sero nocte, in cella primae classis navis “Berries.”

source: In his slumber, Lumian vaguely witnessed the land shrouded in sulfurous flames, and the blood‑colored Demon sprawled within the pitch‑black liquid.
target: In somno, Lumian vage conspexit terram in flammis sulfurosis circumvolutam, atque daemon sanguine coloratus in liquido atri iacentem.
